purpose: Add post-rollback message invalidation tracking and typed 'rollback' event emission to MarmotGroup. After a MIP-03 fork resolution, consumers receive the RollbackInfo payload naming which application messages were decrypted under the now-discarded epoch, the target epoch restored, and the winning commit id.

public_api.name: MarmotGroupEvents.rollback
public_api.description: New entry added to the existing MarmotGroupEvents type. Emitted exactly once per rollback, after the winning commit has been applied.

public_api.name: RollbackInfo.invalidatedMessages
public_api.description: Now populated (previously always []). Event IDs of application messages that were decrypted under the losing epoch's keys and are therefore no longer valid in the winning branch.

owned_data: #messagesByEpoch: Map<bigint, string[]> — in-memory map from epoch bigint to list of application message event IDs decrypted in that epoch
events_emitted: rollback: RollbackInfo — emitted after rollback + winner re-apply succeeds
